Who we are:

We are a team of Proactive, Respectful, Communicative, Candid, Diverse, Equitable and Curious leaders seeking new team members who share our values. We are world-class experience designers, technologists, strategic thinkers and creators assembled to develop global design projects for adventurous, industry-changing Fortune 500 companies and leading organizations.

Who you are:
You are a spatial thinker with an artist’s sensibility. You understand that architecture is not just about buildings—it’s about the way people feel, move, and find meaning in the spaces around them. You work fluidly across scales: from a human-scale sculpture and installation to a building façade or master plan. You are conceptually driven, aesthetically sharp, and more interested in the emotional texture of space than the technical mechanics of construction. You have a portfolio that reflects genuine creative range, a strong point of view, and a hunger to push what the built environment can be.

Role Overview

As a HUSH Architectural Designer, you bring a design sensibility rooted in art, culture, and human experience. You are the creative force that shapes how our spaces look, feel, and resonate—translating brand narratives and human stories into spatial and experiential language. You work across project types and scales, contributing to concept development, mood and aesthetic direction, and the visual logic that guides how a project comes to life. You collaborate closely with designers, technologists, and strategists to ensure every environment we create leaves a lasting impression.

Focus: 80% making and execution; 20% learning and concepting

Key Responsibilities

  • Contribute to spatial concept development—from big ideas to the refined aesthetic details that define a project’s character.

  • Develop mood boards, visual narratives, and inspiration frameworks that guide the creative direction of spaces.

  • Shape the experiential arc of a space—how people enter, move through, pause, and feel in an environment. Journeys, mapping, narratives.

  • Collaborate with designers, technologists and fabricators to translate conceptual vision into realized work.

  • Contribute to pitch development with strong visual storytelling and spatial thinking.

  • Articulate design ideas clearly and compellingly in both visual and verbal form.

  • Seek and embrace feedback. Iterate with intention. Evolve the idea without losing the soul of it.

Evaluation

Bi-annual meetings to review progress across core responsibilities, professional, and personal goals.

Requirements

  • 2–4+ years of design experience in architecture, experience design, spatial design, or a related creative field.

  • Bachelor’s degree in architecture, fine arts, interior design, or equivalent work experience—formal architectural training is appreciated but not required.

  • A portfolio that demonstrates conceptual range, aesthetic sophistication, and comfort working across scales.

  • Strong skills in visual communication: sketching, mood-making, spatial storytelling.

  • Proficiency in tools such as Rhino, Adobe Creative Suite, SketchUp, or similar. 3D rendering, AI rendering.

  • Genuine curiosity for art, culture, technology, and sensorial experience.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills—you are as comfortable in a concept conversation as you are presenting work to a client.

  • Uphold department policies, standards, and best practices

  • AssociateDegree(minimum)in interior architecture, architecture, architectural drafting, or related field

  • Experience in architectural or interior design with strong space planning knowledge

  • Ability to function as a client-facing design lead translating needs into functional solutions

  • Strong understanding of zoning, adjacencies, circulation, accessibility, life safety codes, and construction practices

  • Proficiencyin floor plan development andcreation of constructiondocumentation

  • Proficiencyin AutoCAD/AutoCAD Architecture and Revit; 3D modeling experience a plus

  • Strong organizational and project management skills with ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines

  • Excellent communication skills with ability to convey technical concepts clearly

  • Strong collaboration skills across sales, clients, contractors, and cross-functional teams

  • Self-starter with strong analytical thinking and problem-solving ability

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, detail-oriented environment

  • High attention to detail and commitment to quality and accuracy

  • Familiarity with collaboration and task management tools

  • Commitment to professional standards and workplace policies

MINIMUM WORK EXPERIENCE:

Typically 2 to 4 years of related professional experience.

PREFERRED EDUCATION:

Typically a Bachelor's Degree or global equivalent in related discipline.

TRAVEL / PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

Travel typically less than 10%. Office environment. No special physical demands required.

Senior Designer III – Architecture & Interior Design

Work Arrangement: Remote
Shift: U.S. Business Hours – LATAM Compatible
Engagement: Freelance Independent Contractor
Industry: Architecture, Interior Design & Construction
Compensation: Competitive hourly rate based on experience and qualifications

About the Role

ADDMORE Services LLC is seeking an experienced Senior Designer III with a strong background in Architecture and Interior Design to support the design and delivery of high-quality international projects.

The successful candidate will be an experienced, hands-on designer capable of contributing throughout multiple phases of a project, from concept and schematic design through design development, construction documentation, and project coordination.

This position requires a strong combination of design sensitivity, technical documentation skills, architectural detailing, interior design knowledge, and multidisciplinary coordination.

We are looking for someone who can work with a high degree of autonomy, translate design intent into technically resolved solutions, and collaborate effectively with architects, designers, consultants, contractors, vendors, and clients.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop architectural and interior design solutions from conceptual and schematic design through design development and construction documentation.
  • Produce and coordinate architectural drawings, including plans, elevations, sections, details, reflected ceiling plans, finish plans, and related technical documentation.
  • Develop interior layouts, space-planning solutions, and detailed design packages.
  • Support the selection and specification of materials, finishes, fixtures, furniture, lighting, and FF&E.
  • Develop architectural details, custom millwork, cabinetry, and interior design elements as required.
  • Translate design concepts and client requirements into functional, aesthetically strong, and technically buildable solutions.
  • Coordinate architectural and interior design requirements with MEP, structural, consultants, contractors, vendors, and other disciplines.
  • Review project documentation to identify coordination issues, discrepancies, or constructability concerns.
  • Support the preparation and review of construction documentation and drawing packages.
  • Participate in project meetings and communicate design decisions clearly with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Assist with RFIs, submittals, shop drawings, samples, and other construction-phase documentation when required.
  • Support project managers and design leads throughout project development and delivery.
  • Maintain high standards of design quality, technical accuracy, documentation, and attention to detail.
  • Work independently while managing assigned priorities, deadlines, and project deliverables.

Requirements

  • Degree in Architecture, Interior Architecture, Interior Design, or a closely related field.
  • Approximately 6–10+ years of relevant professional experience in architecture, interior architecture, or interior design.
  • Strong experience delivering residential, commercial, hospitality, retail, workplace, or high-end interior projects.
  • Demonstrated experience working across multiple project phases, including:
    • Concept Design
    • Schematic Design
    • Design Development
    • Construction Documentation
  • Strong experience producing and coordinating technical architectural and interior design drawings.
  • Proficiency in Revit and/or AutoCAD.
  • Strong working knowledge of SketchUp or similar 3D design tools.
  • Experience with Adobe Creative Suite or other design-presentation software is preferred.
  • Strong understanding of materials, finishes, FF&E, lighting, millwork, and architectural detailing.
  • Ability to read, understand, and coordinate architectural, engineering, and construction drawings.
  • Experience coordinating with consultants and multidisciplinary project teams.
  • Strong design judgment combined with practical understanding of construction and constructability.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with international clients and project teams.
  • Strong organizational, problem-solving, and time-management skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment with minimal supervision.
  • Availability to work during U.S. business hours, aligned with the required client and project schedule.
  • Immediate availability or availability within an agreed timeframe is preferred.

Preferred Background

Candidates with experience in any of the following are strongly encouraged to apply:

  • High-End Residential Design
  • Interior Architecture
  • Hospitality Design
  • Commercial Interiors
  • Retail Design
  • Workplace Design
  • Luxury Interiors
  • FF&E
  • Custom Millwork & Cabinetry
  • Construction Documentation
  • BIM / Revit Coordination
  • Multidisciplinary Design Coordination
  • U.S. Architectural or Interior Design Projects
  • International Architecture & Design Projects

Preferred Software & Technical Skills

Experience with some or all of the following is highly desirable:

  • Revit
  • AutoCAD
  • Adobe Photoshop
  • Adobe InDesign
  • Adobe Illustrator
  • BIM coordination tools
  • Project collaboration and document-management platforms

What We Offer

  • Remote work arrangement
  • Competitive hourly compensation based on experience and qualifications
  • Opportunity to work on international architecture and interior design projects
  • Exposure to U.S.-based project teams and clients
  • Opportunity to contribute to high-quality residential, commercial, hospitality, and interior design projects
  • Long-term opportunity for a suitable candidate
  • Professional remote working environment
  • Opportunity to work with multidisciplinary and internationally distributed design teams

Candidate Pre-Screening Form

Interested candidates are requested to complete our Candidate Pre-Screening Form as part of the application process. The form will allow us to review your relevant experience, software proficiency, project background, availability, expected hourly rate, and other information related to the position.

Shortlisted candidates will be contacted regarding the next stage of the recruitment process.

Liberty University seeks adjunct architectural educators and professionals who will make significant contributions to the innovative teaching of architectural subjects and courses within the new Architecture & Design Program.

Teaching will focus on instruction and continued course development toward NAAB accreditation in the areas of architectural environmental systems at the graduate level. In addition, the position may teach design studios as approved by the Director of the Program.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Teaching subject material according to the approved curriculum and assigned schedule to promote student fulfillment, professional training, and academic excellence.

Mentor and inspire students in matters related to exemplary academics, attendance, professionalism, and behaviors, while guiding students in achieving successful completions of clear course objectives, learning outcomes, and quality expectations.

Provide regularly scheduled reviews and assessments of student work and deliver timely feedback and clear revisory strategies toward expected outcomes.

Maintain and report student grades and attendance in accordance with university policies and procedures.

Participate in school retention initiatives by maintaining productive class contact and outreach, while offering assistance to absent and/or at-risk students.

Motivate students to actively participate and support in all aspects of educational, professional, and creative processes in accordance with the program’s code of ethics.

Maintain university standards regarding course activity, emails, grading, and communication with the Instructional Mentor and students.

Maintain continued course development and end-of-semester assessments toward meeting NAAB accreditation goals in communication with the Instructional Mentor.

Strictly adheres to Liberty University policies and The Liberty Way – Student Honor Code, representing the University in an exemplary manner.

Works effectively as a team member, embracing and fostering LU’s Christian model and Mission – Training Champions for Christ.

QUALIFICATIONS, CREDENTIALS, AND COMPETENCIES

Required Qualifications: Master of Architecture (M. Arch) degree or a terminal degree in Architecture from an NAAB accredited institution. Provide evidence of, or the potential for, effective teaching, tested professional expertise, creative/scholarly activity, public communication, and professional collegiality.

Preferred Qualifications: Ph.D. in Architecture or a closely related field to the subject of study (or ABD within one year). Professional experience and licensure for teaching upper-level and advanced courses. Previous teaching experience and creative/scholarly work in areas of disciplinary expertise.

Applicants must demonstrate a personal faith commitment to the Liberty University’s evangelical Christian mission and purpose, plus full adherence to its doctrines.

Demonstrated strength or potential in teaching at the college level, with familiarity in use of collaborative and online learning techniques and student-centered methods of instruction.

Proven organizational skills and ability to complete assignments timely and accurately with minimal supervision.

Possess excellent communication skills and the ability to communicate effectively with students with a wide range of experience, skills, and abilities.

Possess excellent interpersonal, empathetic, customer service, and problem-solving skills, with abilities to work well with students, faculty, and staff, as well as public entities.

ABILITIES AND COMPETENCIES ESSENTIAL TO THE FUNCTION OF THE JOB

Communication and Comprehension

  • Ability to effectively communicate both verbally and in writing to convey clear, well-articulated information.
  • Ability to understand, speak, and write English to convey messages and correspond articulately and professionally.
  • Possess public communication skills that allow professional representation of Liberty University.
  • Strong organizational skills.
  • Computer skills (e.g. discipline-related technologies, online teaching platforms).

Problem Solving

  • Intuitively able to reason, analyze information and events, and apply judgment to solve problems of both a routine and complex nature.

Physical and Sensory Abilities

  • May be required to travel (e.g. local, campus, state, site visits, field work, etc.)
  • May be required to sit to perform deskwork or type on a keyboard.
  • Regularly required to hear and speak to effectively communicate orally.
  • Regularly required to stand, walk, and climb stairs to move about the campus.
  • Handle materials, reach overhead, kneel or stoop to conduct business.
  • Regularly lift 10 or fewer pounds. (Edit if duties require higher weight.)

WORKING CONDITIONS

Work Environment

The working environment in which one will typically perform the essential functions of this position is a climate-controlled setting. It is well-lit, and the noise level is moderate. The working environment may include the facilitation of events outdoors occasionally.

Driving Requirements

If the employee is required to travel in performing the duties and responsibilities of the position, the use of one’s personal vehicle (or LU vehicles) may be required for travel. Proof of a valid driver’s license, an acceptable DMV record, LU Driving Approval, and liability insurance is required when driving in the performance of the employee’s position.
